facts.name: Edward C. Spaight
facts.assignment: Citrus county judge; profile includes civil case-management and probate/guardianship submission procedures. Full division allocation remains county reconciliation.

contact.contact_note: Office/assistant shared route; no personal judicial email or distinct assistant-only telephone established.

chambers_communications.summary: Email assistant for scheduling, copying all parties. Profile prohibits direct merits communication. Probate/guardianship correspondence goes through portal except hearing requests or court-requested submissions.

hearing_scheduling.summary: Email assistant rather than telephone with case/county, motion and total time. Coordinate offered times with all parties, confirm selection and supply courtesy notice. Scheduling impasse goes to court by motion documenting attempts. Cross-noticing needs office permission.

proposed_orders.summary: Submit only when ready for immediate entry, through e-Portal Judiciary (Court)–Citrus, in .docx using linked sample format. Profile lists motions requiring accompanying proposed orders; retain link for detail.

courtesy_copies.summary: Electronic case law/memoranda to assistant at least ten days before hearing; physically submitted binders/materials at least one week ahead. Virtual-hearing evidence must be physically delivered in advance; court does not print it.

remote_appearances.summary: Zoom meeting9245591031; no individual invites. Functional camera/speaker/microphone and active camera required; inability to use camera calls for in-person or telephone setting. Court alone records; noncompliance may cause in-person resetting. No blanket eligibility inferred.

cancellations.summary: Movant files cancellation and gives courtesy copy. Court-set cancellation sentence ends after voluntary dismissal with prejudice and a comma; no missing alternatives inferred. Continuance motion includes grounds/opponent position, courtesy copy and proposed order; agreement does not guarantee approval.

case_management.summary: Send courtesy cause-at-issue notice. Linked March2023 standing order directs service of order and referenced AO with summons and uses track/management requirements. Profile separately links A-2024-59; operative relationship not resolved. Detailed litigation deadlines retained in original rather than repeated.

facts.summary: Email-coordinated hearings, portal Word orders, distinct electronic/physical courtesy-copy lead times and physical virtual-hearing evidence. Dated standing-order and newer linked authority remain separate evidence.

review_scope.collected: Complete profile HTML and two-page linked county standing order; extracted text and source hashes.
review_scope.content_reviewed: Contacts, recurring hearing/submission/remote/cancellation/case-management routing; standing-order heading, sections1–4 and signature date.
review_scope.not_reviewed: Detailed deadline tables, sanctions, mediation merits, injunction forms and incapacity forms. Shared A-2024-59 and A-2026-13-A links retained for county material-rule review; no assertion that merely linked rules were reviewed.
